sys_uib_toolbox_component.description: Record header + configurable action bar in one component. Fetches the record from Table + Record Sys ID (display values, so choice/reference fields read as their labels), shows the primary value, tags, subheading and up-to-seven secondary label/value pairs (plain, highlighted status, or reference link), and renders an action bar of text / iconic / split / menu buttons with per-action conditional hide and disable, an automatic overflow menu, and whole-bar hide/disable. Emits the full record as JSON so a page can store it. Optional background image (transparent PNG/SVG) with free-form horizontal and vertical positioning and size. Includes a pin toggle and a pinned-items drawer backed by a shared localStorage list, so pins made here appear in every component that reads the same key.
sys_uib_toolbox_component.label: Workspace Header
